item.subject: maths
item.stem:
The graph shows rainfall in millimetres for City P and City Q across four months.

Which claim about this display is correct?

options.A: A line graph with two lines shows how each city's rainfall changes across the months and makes the comparison clear.
options.B: The graph is a pie chart of the rainfall totals.
options.C: Clustered bars for every month are required, because a line graph cannot show two cities.
options.D: Only the tallest plotted point matters for comparing the two cities.
